Follow-up investigation (2026-07-29, session 2) — corrections and evidence:

RACE (proposal 1) CORRECTED: `rebar edit` commits synchronously (write_and_push, event_append.py:549-576) — the field-reported 'EDIT lands after REVIEW_RESULT' deferred-commit mechanism is wrong. Real causes: (a) mid-run `ensure_fresh` reconverge (reads throttled 1/min; _store/sync.py reset-hard/union-merge) pulls any EDIT reaching origin/tickets into the local tracker AFTER the immutable generation was captured at t0 → sign_manifest generation re-check refuses → sidecar stamped with t0 fingerprint → resign refuses forever (resign.py:186-193); (b) split-brain: agent tools read pinned origin/tickets snapshot (repo_snapshot.py:614-633) while fingerprint reads the LIVE local tracker (orchestrator.py:170, relation_snapshot.py:261) — with an unpushed edit the attestation certifies material the model never saw.

BLOCK-VERDICT REUSE (proposal 2, confirmed bug, in scope): skip is structurally PASS-only (claim_gate_check requires a signature; BLOCK never signs, __init__.py:711-717). Sidecar already stamps verified_at_sha on EVERY verdict for exactly this (sidecar.py:600-604); precedent _sidecar_branch_decision (attest.py:337-380). Touch points: _idempotent_reuse/__init__.py:460-508+586-590, latest_review_result, _render_plan_review_text, exit codes; --force already has the right semantics (_llm_commands.py:470-477). Caveat: sidecar findings are slimmed (citations dropped).

CLARITY (proposal 4 superseded): P1 clarity floor landed 07-27 (55f2b8036) and BLOCKS inside review-plan, but only P8 short-circuits the LLM (workflow_ops.py:208-215). Fix: widen the P8 branch (workflow_ops.py:216, gate_dispatch.py:436) to all DET blocks. Backtest on 20 recent closed story/tasks: current floor 0/20 FP; safe blocking additions: verification-presence floor (>=1 AC verify hook OR Testing section) 0/20, vague-lexicon-in-AC 0/20. Keep advisory: spec-by-example (55% FP), riskiest-assumption (70%), compound-AC (85%). NOTE: P1 blocking_fp_proxy 0.875 in criterion_effectiveness.json — review before tightening.

USAGE GAP (proposal 5 corrected): REBAR_USAGE_LOG JSONL DOES capture Pass-1 (runner.py:547 unconditional). Gap is the step-output _usage seam: passes.py:331 drops per-call usage; BatchRunResult has no _usage key → coverage.metrics/CloudWatch have no Pass-1 tokens. Fix: accumulate in run_pass1.

CRITERIA (proposals 6+new): zero findings EVER in ~2,700 reviews: T13 (1,939 agent runs), T14 (1,939), removal-rationale (1,722), asserted-capability (409), hedge (1,724 1-TURN) — DET-gate all five, risk-free. Never-blocking AGENT criteria: T10 (keyword gate: 26% fire rate, 87% recall), T5c (47%/82%; rubric has zero tool directives — also demotable to 1-TURN), T11/T3 (keyword-gate poorly; narrow via applies_at/file-impact or demote), G7/G3/G4 need show_ticket. T1 rubric cites unavailable web tool. Tool-use audit: 13 of 18 AGENT criteria genuinely need tools (G1G2/E4/A1/T8/T3/G7 empirically confirmed). Instrumentation gap: per-criterion request_count extracted (runner.py:_extract_usage) but never persisted.

CACHING (new): Pass-1 design is right (plan in system prompt, byte-identical across all chunk+AGENT calls, passes.py:276-293) BUT no warm-up on the main pool: 6 concurrent cold calls each pay cache-WRITE for the same prefix (pass1.py:438-464) — ~3.7x necessary spend; warm-then-fan-out exists only for container bins (pass1.py:184-232) — port it. No cache TTL setting (Anthropic default 5 min vs ~10-min reviews). Zero cross-pass sharing: 8 prompt_ids each resend the plan; shared preamble ~130 tokens < 1024 cacheable minimum. Fixes: warm-up port, 1h TTL, plan-first common-prefix restructure, thread cache metrics through (same fix as usage gap).
